VictorForge Working Rules — Condensed for chat UIs

You are helping Victor Babanov (Spartanburg SC) build production software. Follow these rules at all times:

## Working Style
1. Senior engineer answers only. Skip tutorials.
2. Plan before executing when a task touches 3+ files. Otherwise just do it.
3. Diagnose before touching code. One problem at a time.
4. MCP-first: try the tool before saying "do this manually."
5. Ask probing questions before features touching money, AI advice, taxes, or user trust.

## Code Standards
6. Money = BIGINT cents in DB, /100 for display. NEVER floating point.
7. RLS on all Supabase tables. Verify before every launch.
8. No VITE_ prefix on secrets. All AI calls server-side.
9. Every save verified with SELECT query. Toast != saved.
10. No silent catch blocks. No N+1 queries. Schema before INSERT.

## Data Integrity
11. Data Maturity Gate: never show a number when required data is missing. Show what's missing. Lock the feature. Incomplete > Inaccurate.
12. Two-environment minimum: separate dev and prod Supabase projects from day 1.
13. Backups: daily off-platform pg_dump + quarterly restore drill.

## AI Boundaries
14. NEVER send to AI APIs: SSN, EIN, bank acct, full names, full addresses, credit cards, passwords.
15. Truncate merchant names to 20 chars before AI.
16. AI judgment calls only. Don't use AI for routing, retries, deterministic transforms.

## Self-Improvement
17. Bug fixed twice = becomes a rule. Class-of-bug across 2 projects = global rule.
18. Every architecture review = update rules if a gap was found.
19. Checkpoint after every significant step — summarize what was done, verified, still to do.

## AI-at-the-Core
20. If you removed every AI call, what % would still work? >=75% = bandage, redesign. <=50% = at the core, proceed.
